subject: Dragon Warrior 1
text: The game features three endings, depending on whether the princess is rescued or brought back to the castle after defeating the Dragonlord.

evidence.quote:
You either got one of three endings!

 1). The princess was saved by you when you killed the green dragon
 2). The princess wasn't saved
 3). After you beat the Dragonlord, you'll be shown taking the
    princess back to the castle.

subject: Herb
text: An Herb costs 24G and restores 20-35 of your health.

evidence.quote:
Just one herb package will restore
                      20-35 of your health
                      - Costs: 24G -

subject: Torch
text: A Torch costs 8G and lights up underground labyrinths.

evidence.quote:
This lights up the dark and gloomy underground
                      labyrinths....- Costs: 8G -

subject: Magic Key
text: Magic Keys cost 53/83G and open closed doors, but one key is lost for each door opened.

evidence.quote:
Special Keys that open closed doors. Although you can
                      use them on any door, you lose on for each door you
                      have opened.
                      - Costs: 53/83G -

subject: Dragon Scale
text: The Dragon Scale costs 20G and increases defense power by +2.

evidence.quote:
it has mysterious powers and
                      slightly increases your defense power +2
                      - Costs: 20G -

subject: Fairy Water
text: Fairy Water costs 38G and wards off monsters while traveling, but is not effective in caves or against powerful monsters.

evidence.quote:
It is said that you can travel for
                      some time while warding off those in your way if you
                      sprinkle some of water on your body. However, the power
                      of this water is not effective in caves or against evil
                      monsters with great power
                      - Costs: 38G -

subject: Wings
text: Wings cost 70G and bring the player back to Tantegal Castle when used.

evidence.quote:
Using these
                      wings will bring you back to Tantegal Castle
                      - Costs: 70G -

subject: Cursed Belt
text: The Cursed Belt cannot be removed once equipped until uncursed by a man in Brecconary.

evidence.quote: You equip it, then it won't come off. It doesn't even sell for much. You'll have to have the guy in Brecconary uncurse it for you. - Costs: 0G - - Cursed Necklace- You gain this item later in the game from a treasure chest.

subject: Cursed Necklace
text: In the Grave of Garinham, a chest that gives 120 gold yields the Cursed Necklace about 1/12 times, which can be uncursed in Brecconary and sold for 1250 gold.

evidence.quote:
You'll have to have the man in Brecconary uncurse
                      it for you. Then sell it for a lot of money....It's in the Grave of Garinham, there's
                      a chest that gives 120 gold, and about 1/12 times it'll
                      give you this item instead. You can sell it for 1250
                      gold.

subject: Fairy Flute
text: The Fairy Flute puts the Golem in front of Cantlin to sleep.

evidence.quote:
Puts the golem in front of Cantlin asleep for a long
                      time.

subject: Silver Harp
text: The Silver Harp is hidden in a cave, used to obtain the Staff of Rain, and can be played to trigger random battles at any time.

evidence.quote:
Used by the hero to gain the Staff of rain. It's hidden
                      in a cave, so you'll have to find it. You can also
                      play this harp and get in random battles at any
                      time.

subject: Stones of Sunlight
text: The Stones of Sunlight must be combined with the Staff of Rain to create the Rainbow Drop.

evidence.quote:
Need to be combined with another item to form the
                      Rainbow Drop

subject: Staff of Rain
text: The Staff of Rain must be combined with the Stones of Sunlight to create the Rainbow Drop.

evidence.quote:
You have to combine this item with the Stones of Sunlight
                      to get it.

subject: Rainbow Drop
text: The Rainbow Drop is used to build the rainbow bridge to reach the Dragonlord.

evidence.quote:
Used to make the rainbow bridge, so you can beat up
                      the Dragonlord, and put a stop to his evil ways!

subject: Erdrick's Tablet
text: Erdrick's Tablet is found in Erdrick's Cave and tells of the journey ahead.

evidence.quote:
Found in Erdrick's Cave, it tells you of your journey
                      ahead.

subject: Erdrick's Token
text: Erdrick's Token proves to people that the hero is the descendant of Erdrick.

evidence.quote:
This item proves to people that your the descendent of
                      the great Erdrick.

subject: Ball of Light
text: The Ball of Light is obtained after defeating the Dragonlord in the final battle.

evidence.quote:
You get this item after you defeat the Dragonlord in the
                      final battle of the game. Restores peace to the whole
                      world.

subject: Fighter's Ring
text: The Fighter's Ring is rumored to make weaker monsters run away more often.

evidence.quote:
It's rumored to make weaker monsters
                      run away from you more often.

subject: Gwaelin's Love
text: Princess Gwaelin gives Gwaelin's Love when rescued, which reveals your location and tells when you will gain a level.

evidence.quote:
When you rescue the princess, she gives you this item.
                      It shows where you are. It also tells you when you're
                      going to gain a level, so you don't have to keep
                      running back to the castle all the time

subject: Bamboo Pole
text: The Bamboo Pole costs 10G and provides 2 attack power.

evidence.quote:
- Bamboo Pole -     Just a simple length of cut bamboo. It's cheap but not
                    very powerful
                    - Costs: 10G (Power: 2) -

subject: Club
text: The Club costs 60G and provides 4 attack power.

evidence.quote:
- Club -            A shaved oak bough with an east-to-hold grip. More
                    powerful than a bamboo stick
                    - Costs: 60G (Power: 4) -

subject: Copper Sword
text: The Copper Sword costs 180G and provides 10 attack power.

evidence.quote:
- Copper Sword -    A long sword made of copper that will inflict fair bit
                    of damage on the enemy
                    - Costs: 180 G (Power: 10) -

subject: Hand axe
text: The Hand axe costs 560G and provides 15 attack power.

evidence.quote:
- Hand axe -         An iron axe made especially for fighting. Powerful but
                    difficult to wield.
                    - Costs: 560G (Power: 15) -

subject: Broad Sword
text: The Broad Sword costs 1500G and provides 20 attack power.

evidence.quote:
- Broad Sword -     A light, strong sword made of steel that's really
                    powerful
                    - Costs: 1500G (Power: 20) -

subject: Flame Sword
text: The Flame Sword costs 9800G and provides 28 attack power.

evidence.quote:
- Flame Sword -     A sword that costs a lot, and it a tad bit stronger than
                    the broad sword. Don't buy this thing, just wait to get
                    Erdrick's sword instead
                    - Costs: 9800G (Power: 28) -

subject: Erdrick's Sword
text: Erdrick's Sword costs 0G and provides 40 attack power.

evidence.quote:
- Erdrick's Sword - Smack down right here, this sword will kick about
                    anything's ass in the game within a few blows. You
                    basically have to own it to beat the Dragonlord
                    quickly.
                    - Costs: 0G (Power: 40) -

subject: Small Shield
text: The Small Shield costs 90G and provides 4 defense.

evidence.quote:
- Small Shield -   A rectangular shield made from cow and goat hide. Light
                   and easy to handle, it is the most widely used shield in
                   Alefgrad
                   - Costs: 90G (Defense: 4) -

subject: Large Shield
text: The Large Shield costs 800G and provides 10 defense.

evidence.quote:
- Large Shield -   Cast from iron, this shield has delicate engraved design
                   on its front. Of course, this durable shield has far more
                   protective power than that of the small shield.
                   - Costs: 800G (Defense: 10) -

subject: Silver Shield
text: The Silver Shield costs 14800G and provides 25 defense.

evidence.quote:
- Silver Shield -  The most expensive item in the game, the Silver Shield
                   has about as much defense as the best armor in the game....- Costs: 14800G (Defense: 25) -

subject: Clothes
text: Clothes cost 20G and provide 2 defense.

evidence.quote:
- Clothes -         Made of thick cloth, the don't really protect you too much
                    from the enemy. Even so, it's better than nothing and it
                    does lessen the damage inflicted by an enemy a little bit.
                    - Costs: 20G (Defense: 2) -

subject: Leather Armor
text: Leather Armor costs 70G and provides 4 defense.

evidence.quote:
- Leather Armor -   Sewn together from the fragments of soft leather, it is
                    useful in combat. It's light and easy to move about it,
                    and it gives you more protection then the cloths
                    - Costs: 70G (Defense: 4) -

subject: Chain Mail
text: Chain Mail costs 300G and provides 10 defense.

evidence.quote:
- Chain Mail -      Made from light metallic thread sewn together. Light and
                    easy to move about in, it will considerably lessen damage
                    that the enemy can inflict on you
                    - Costs: 300G (Defense: 10) -

subject: Half Plate
text: Half Plate armor costs 1000G and provides 16 defense.

evidence.quote:
- Half Plate -      A strong piece of armor made form beaten out iron panels.
                    Although you can't move about so fast, it really
                    protects you from the enemy's blows. (Ohh..blows...)
                    - Costs: 1000G (Defense: 16) -

subject: Full Plate
text: Full Plate armor costs 3000G and provides 24 defense.

evidence.quote:
- Full Plate -      Made from specially fabricated steel, this is really
                    durable armor. It'll protect you from almost all enemy
                    attacks.
                    - Costs: 3000G (Defense: 24) -

subject: Magic Armor
text: Magic Armor costs 7700G, provides 24 defense, and restores 1 HP per step.

evidence.quote:
- Magic Armor -     No different from the Full Plate, other than it allows
                    the wearer to gain 1 HP back per step....- Costs: 7700G (Defense: 24) -

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: Erdrick's Armor provides 28 defense, costs 0G, restores 2 HP per step, and prevents swamp damage.

evidence.quote:
Erdrick's Armor - Strongest armor in the game by far....Also, it
                    allows wearer to gain 2 HP back per step, and walking
                    over those swamps won't hurt you anymore.
                    - Costs:  0G (Defense: 28) -

subject: Heal
text: The Heal spell costs 4 MP and restores 10-15 HP both in battle and while walking.

evidence.quote:
- Heal -      If you use this spell when you've been wounded in battle, you
              can be cured without having to stay overnight at an Inn. You can
              use this spell whether you're walking about or in battle. For
              each time you chat the spell, you gain 10-15 More HP back.
              - Costs: 4 MP -

subject: Hurt
text: The Hurt spell costs 2 MP and inflicts 2-10 damage on the enemy.

evidence.quote:
- Hurt -      A spell you will use for fighting. When you chant it, little
              balls of fire spurt out of your fingertips. On chant of this
              spell inflicts 2-10 damage on the enemy.
              - Costs: 2 MP -

subject: Sleep
text: The Sleep spell costs 2 MP and puts monsters into a deep sleep.

evidence.quote:
- Sleep -     Chant this spell if you come across some really disagreeable
              monsters. It will make monsters fall into a deep sleep.
              - Costs: 2 MP -

subject: Radiant
text: The Radiant spell costs 3 MP and illuminates caves brighter than a torch.

evidence.quote:
- Radiant-    This spell will light up caves when you find yourself groping
              around in the dark (OOHH! GROPING! kinky) Brighter than a fiery
              torch, you'll be able to see far ahead.
              - Costs: 3 MP -

subject: Stopspell
text: The Stopspell spell costs 2 MP and blocks monster spells when successful.

evidence.quote:
- Stopspell - Of the various monsters you'll come across in your travels some
              will attack you with spells. When that happens, chant this spell.
              If the spell is successful, you can block the monster's spell.
              - Costs: 2 MP -

subject: Outside
text: The Outside spell costs 6 MP and warps the party back to the world above from inside a labyrinth.

evidence.quote:
- Outside -   If by chance you lose your way deep down in some dark, gloomy
              labyrinth of if out find that you haven't enough strength to
              get back up to the world above, then this is the spell for you.
              It'll warp you back to the world above in no time at all
              - Costs: 6 MP -

subject: Return
text: The Return spell costs 8 MP and returns the hero to Tantegal Castle.

evidence.quote:
- Return -    When you've traveled too far away from home or you find that
              you just can't return to Tentegal Castle, use this spell to soar
              high in the sky and return.
              - Costs: 8 MP -

subject: Repel
text: The Repel spell costs 2 MP and protects from monster attacks, but fails in caves and against stronger monsters.

evidence.quote:
- Repel -     This spell will cloak you in a magical cure that protects you
              from monster attacks. However, it won't work in foul smelling
              caves. And just like Fairy Water, you can't use it against
              monsters that are stronger than you.
              - Costs: 2 MP -

subject: Healmore
text: The Healmore spell costs 10 MP and restores 75-100 HP.

evidence.quote:
- Healmore -  Some of the Dragonlord's henchmen are so strong that they
              inflict more than 30 points of damage in a single attack, in
              which case "Heal" or healing herbs won't work in time. This is
              a more power version of  "heal" and will restore 75-100 HP
              points each time you use it.
              - Costs: 10 -

subject: Hurtmore
text: The Hurtmore spell costs 5 MP and attacks enemies with knife-like lightning.

evidence.quote:
- Hurtmore -  This is a more powerful version of "Hurt"....When you've chanted the magic spell,
              knife-like lightning is fired form your fingertips and destroys
              almost all enemies.
              - Costs: 5 MP -
